title: On Safety Risks in Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) on safety benchmarks (BrowserART, Agent-SafetyBench, SafeAgentBench) before and after experience accumulation, and using manual case inspection alongside Integrated Gradients (IG) attribution to analyze how benign, action-oriented experiences increase the agent's propensity to execute tasks rather than refuse unsafe instructions.
